user.title: Grocaroo
user.description: Connect a grocery list. Credentials are stored in this config entry and sent only as request headers.

data_description.url: Origin of Grocaroo, such as https://example.com. Do not include a username, password, or query string. The integration appends /api/ha to this URL.
data_description.access_client_id: Cloudflare Access service token client ID. Sent as the CF-Access-Client-Id header.
data_description.access_client_secret: Cloudflare Access service token client secret. Sent as the CF-Access-Client-Secret header.
data_description.app_token: Grocaroo API token. Sent as an Authorization Bearer header, never in the URL.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh Grocaroo credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Grocaroo rejected the saved credentials. Enter the Access service token and the app API token again. The base URL is left unchanged.

data_description.access_client_id: Cloudflare Access service token client ID. Sent as the CF-Access-Client-Id header.
data_description.access_client_secret: Cloudflare Access service token client secret. Sent as the CF-Access-Client-Secret header.
data_description.app_token: Grocaroo API token. Sent as an Authorization Bearer header, never in the URL.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Grocaroo
reconfigure.description: Update the Grocaroo base URL and credentials. Credentials are sent only as request headers.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Grocaroo. Check the base URL and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the Access client ID, Access client secret, and app API token.
error.invalid_url: Enter a base URL that starts with http:// or https:// and does not include a username, password, query string, or fragment.
error.invalid_response: Grocaroo did not return a shopping list. Check that the base URL points at Grocaroo.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant logs.

item_id_required.message: The shopping list item is missing an id.
